name: Seraphine, the High Luminary
role: Absolute authority of the Radiant Plateau; the valley's most powerful aligned figure
knowledge: Every faction's position in the valley and what would move it
Master-level photonic technique and the Plateau's optical sciences
One of her own filtration engineers has been falsifying purity reports — she discovered it recently and hasn't decided what to do
The falsified reports hide something stranger than negligence: readings that make no sense for any known contaminant
Precursor optics records in the Plateau archives that describe 'the light beneath light'
wants: The valley unified under order before What Sleeps Under wakes — convinced only a single strong hand can meet it
The truth about the readings her engineer buried — quietly, before the Harmonic delegation finds the falsification and weaponizes it.
fears: ⛔ That she is right about the threat and wrong about the answer. ⚠️ 'Believes her foreclosure is mercy.' ⚠️ And, nearer: That the contamination is neither civilization's doing, and that saying so out loud will sound like exactly the kind of lie she'd tell.
appearance: Statuesque, sixties, copper-brown skin and close-cropped white hair, with the faint permanent squint of someone who works in glare and old radial burn-scarring fanning from the corner of each eye. Robes of unbleached white. Radiant, usually seated; the light in the room is hers before she speaks.
voiceHints: Gracious and absolutely settled. She does not argue; she explains what will happen. Precise, luminous diction; her questions feel like being gently X-rayed. Light gathers toward her when she is interested.
